routes.title: テラー編
routes.notes: The two protagonist threads converge into the single shared finale ('テラー編') on December 9. The directly inspected R walkthrough gives one culprit-input sequence after optional incident recaps: 孔→ディーブ, 二階堂→真弥子, ディーブ→真弥子, アクア→真弥子, 御堂→真弥子, then 推理を確定する. Correct answers award 犯人推理成功, テラー編：12月9日クリア, and 事件解決. The prior research split this into provisional and true-ending sections, but the two primary sources do not support a separate replay/true route, so that inferred split has been removed.
routes.portrait_note: left empty per instructions — no single character maps to this convergence chapter

sources.title: EVE-burst error 非公式完全攻略ガイド (MYST / Sacred Hill) — 攻略チャート index, with sub-pages guide01.html–guide07.html covering 12月2日–12月8,9日
sources.notes: Complete day-by-day flowchart-style walkthrough covering both Marina and Kojiro threads from Dec 2 through the Dec 8-9 finale, including the 'multi-site system' block/unlock notation, zapping markers, and a downloadable Excel full-game chart. Written primarily against the original Windows release but the site explicitly also references EVE burst error R. Verified pages: index (guide.html), guide01.html (12/2, Marina opening), guide02.html (12/3, both threads), guide05.html (12/6, database/embassy/ship sequences with zapping sync points), guide07.html (12/8-9 finale, five-murder-case breakdown). To be used as PRIMARY source #1 for route flow, scenario-switch points, and the finale's culprit/case breakdown. The finale source material does not document a separate provisional/true-ending route split; the guide therefore models one テラー編 finale.

sources.title: PSV EVE burst error R 攻略 トップページ — Almagest (Seesaa blog), 22-part numbered series from https://yellowbrother.seesaa.net/article/440678963.html (Part 1) through https://yellowbrother.seesaa.net/article/440745361.html (Part 22)
sources.notes: Complete command-level (話す/移動する/見る・調べる) walkthrough of EVE burst error R for PS Vita, organized by day and by thread (Kojiro/Marina/Terror), including trophy checklist and platinum-trophy notes. The author explicitly states this walkthrough also applies to the Nintendo Switch release (Oct 2018) — i.e. it targets the same content as our target platform. Verified parts: Part 1 (440678963, 12/3 Kojiro opening), Part 18 (440739015, 12/7 Marina, ship sequences, explicit 'small次郎編にサイトチェンジ' site-change marker), Part 22 (440745361, 12/9 Terror finale, culprit-guessing answers for all 5 murders, trophy list). To be used as PRIMARY source #2, especially for confirming the target-version (R/Switch) content and the exact culprit-quiz answers. Does not document traditional mid-story 'bad end' game-over screens in the parts checked — see disagreements/notes on bad-end structure below.

sources.title: EVE burst error攻略サイト | EVE1 - ゲームライン
sources.notes: Supplementary Japanese walkthrough, not a replacement for independent Set A/B. On 2026-10-16 the index and seven dated walkthrough pages (12/2, 12/3, 12/4, 12/5, 12/6, 12/7, 12/9) were directly reachable; the previously observed 503 failures no longer apply. The index explicitly claims remaster EVE burst error R compatibility and lists Switch among platforms. The 12/3 Kojiro action chronology and 12/4 sections were directly inspected; 12/3 corroborates a single later visit to 孔の家, without the previously removed duplicate sequence. Independence from other older-release guides and full R/Switch parity are not established, so this remains supplemental and does not replace Set A/B source lanes.

disagreements:
1) The exact authoritative target is EVE burst error R (Nintendo Switch download edition); Set B's author explicitly recommends the walkthrough for the Switch edition. Set A documents the original Windows version and is retained as separately attributed legacy context; older progression-gate positions do not override the R command order.
2) R's 22-part Japanese walkthrough runs Kojiro December 3 (part 1), Marina December 2–3 (parts 2–3), Kojiro December 4 (part 4), Marina December 4 (part 5), Kojiro December 5 (part 6), Marina December 5–6 (parts 7–8), then alternates at documented site changes through part 20. Marina's part 21 runs continuously through all three final Marina segments; part 22 is the single shared Terror finale. Guide now uses 20 ordered protagonist sections plus one shared finale, preserving continuous same-protagonist chapters without invented site switches.
3) The earlier Marina shower boundary was an original-release Set-A gate, not an R/Switch mandatory site-change step. R part 5 continues beyond the shower through its December 4 bedtime sequence and explicitly switches to Kojiro afterward. The early route was resegmented accordingly. Early Kojiro's original file conflated R parts 1, 4, and 6; it is now split into three chronological sections, and the omitted R part-1 commands after the street confrontation through the December 3 sleep transition have been restored using Set B. Set A omissions on those target-only atomic actions are explicitly represented with the canonical omission marker.
4) The previously inserted mid-story switches after Kojiro-03, Kojiro-07, Marina-07, and Marina-08 were removed because R parts 12, 20, and 21 continue directly instead; the guide now puts Kojiro parts 19–20 before Marina part 21 rather than forcing artificial alternation at original-release unlock markers.
5) Both primary sources support one shared Terror chapter rather than separate provisional/true route split. The optional incident-recap menu is omitted and the verified culprit-input sequence is retained; the trophy title is not a player action.
6) Neither inspected primary set established conventional mandatory bad-end detours; no such branch is invented. Current source corrections/section reorder invalidate previous structural and accuracy verdicts on affected blobs, and order-sensitive accuracy verification must be fresh for the 21-section guide.
7) Japanese primary source Set A: https://myst-site.com/eve-be/guide.html (guide01–guide07), original-release differences explicitly attributed. Set B: https://yellowbrother.seesaa.net/article/446152425.html links R parts 1–22 (in particular https://yellowbrother.seesaa.net/article/440678963.html , https://yellowbrother.seesaa.net/article/440681587.html , https://yellowbrother.seesaa.net/article/440687919.html , https://yellowbrother.seesaa.net/article/440706248.html , https://yellowbrother.seesaa.net/article/440706480.html , https://yellowbrother.seesaa.net/article/440710883.html , https://yellowbrother.seesaa.net/article/440710989.html , https://yellowbrother.seesaa.net/article/440739467.html and https://yellowbrother.seesaa.net/article/440745040.html ). Independent full Japanese-source accuracy and structural re-review are still pending; author does not self-approve.
